svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.02k stars in total, about 1.64k a year earlier. mr boxington 635, aube 2054, fnox 2325, hk 1292, pitchfork 699, usage 1066, +6 more 953.
